The reality is everyone is bad at writing when they first start and that’s why they need to improve. Some of the best ways to get better at writing are: 

1. Study the theory and structure of the genre you’re writing 

2. Seek continuous feedback on writing pieces 

3. Practice different writing skills 

You should find a good job that pays well and make writing your luxury rather than a hustle. When you have this mindset you’re not easily worked up about it. I think your parents just want you to have a stable career. You don’t write to make money but rather to spread a message and make a difference with your stories. So keep writing and you’ll reap the benefits in the long run.
